character.lede: A brick farmhouse with front gables, a dark shingle roof and a white-columned porch stands on the lake. The ground floor opens through book-lined rooms, past a grand piano in the Library, to a pool garden.

spots.line: Shelves to the ceiling, a grand piano, and the Core on the writing desk.
A bistro table, two chairs and a fireplace make a place to linger.
Two chesterfield sofas and a wingback chair gather round the television stand.

facts.style: Queen Anne brick farmhouse: a cascade of front gables over a dark shingle roof with twin chimneys and dormers, white-columned front porch, book-lined open ground floor, lakeside pool garden

character.truths: The Core sits on the writing desk in the Library. The Nursery is a spare room and is never a scene. Pool, loungers, pergola and garden beds on the lake side. Cousins are visitors, never named.

signatureStack.name: Solidtime
signatureStack.seed: Sally logs the week's hours by client in Solidtime at the Library shelves.
signatureStack.line: Solidtime records a joiner's hours by job in a timer and a weekly view.

signatureStack.name: IT-Tools
signatureStack.seed: John pastes a token into IT-Tools and reads its claims, the tool running in the browser tab.
signatureStack.line: IT-Tools holds the small developer utilities, from a colour picker to a token decoder, in one page.

signatureStack.name: Mindustry Server
signatureStack.seed: Steve starts a Mindustry Server world on the Core, and the cousins join from their own game clients on the home Wi-Fi.
signatureStack.line: Mindustry Server hosts the cousins' factory world on the Core, so the world runs on the Core.

signatureStack.name: Beatsync
signatureStack.seed: Jean and Steve join four phones to one Beatsync queue on the loungers, so the pool garden plays the same track.
signatureStack.line: Beatsync joins every phone in the garden to one queue, so the lawn plays the same track together.

signatureStack.name: LibrePhotos
signatureStack.seed: Steve lets LibrePhotos sort the lake weekend by place, then finds the jetty picture with one search.
signatureStack.line: LibrePhotos sorts the holiday folders by place and face on the Core and finds the beach day in one search.

signatureStack.name: Aider
signatureStack.seed: John asks Aider to tidy a module, then reads each commit it made before he keeps any of them.
signatureStack.line: Aider edits the code and commits each change, so the builder reads it and can undo it.

signatureStack.name: Open Notebook
signatureStack.seed: Jean puts three articles and her class notes into one Open Notebook notebook and asks for the argument they share.
signatureStack.line: Open Notebook gathers three articles and the lecture notes into one notebook and answers from them.

signatureStack.name: CryptPad
signatureStack.seed: The consultancy drafts the proposal in a CryptPad document, and each edit appears as it is typed.
signatureStack.line: CryptPad opens a shared pad and a kanban board that two people edit together at home.
